title: The SR-71 Spy Plane Leaked Fuel on Purpose Until It Got Hot

scenes.text: This Mach 3 spy plane leaked fuel on purpose.
The SR-71 Blackbird's panels were fitted loose on the ground.
Its fuel tanks were built into the plane's skin.
When cold, it dripped jet fuel onto the runway.
At Mach 3, the airframe heated up and grew several inches, closing the gaps.
It leaked on the ground, then flew at Mach 3 and 80,000 feet.

description:
The SR-71 Blackbird was built with loose panels that leaked jet fuel on the ground.
Its fuel tanks were part of the skin, and at Mach 3 the heat expanded the airframe several inches and sealed the gaps.
Would you fly in a plane that leaks on the runway?
